title: Expanded geographic distribution and dietary strategies of the earliest Oldowan hominins and Paranthropus

passages.quote: The 3.032-2.581 Ma Oldowan sites from Nyayanga evidence hippo butchery, plant processing, and the first Paranthropus from SW Kenya.

file.method: Passages of about 500 characters either side of each cited quotation, cut from the fetched page text.
